 Social Security recipients will soon receive COLA notices outlining their 2027 benefits and the upcoming 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment to their monthly checks. 
 As Americans face rising costs for healthcare, transportation, electronics and grocery staples, the 2027 COLA will increase retirement checks by an average of $75 per month.
 COLA notices are expected to be available online in late November, with paper notices arriving a few weeks later.

 In its Oct. 14 announcement of the 2027 cost-of-living adjustment , the Social Security Administration said COLA notices will be released online "starting in late November — up to three weeks earlier than receiving a paper notice in the mail."
 In a post on X Monday , the agency confirmed that "Your 2027 COLA notice is on the way!"
 Users can also sign up for text or email alerts for new messages from Social Security, including their notice. Beneficiaries can set up alerts and access their notice online when it's available through their my Social Security account .
 "Individuals who do not have a personal account will need to create one and enroll in paperless notices by November 18 to see their COLA notice online," the announcement read. They will then receive an alert in the "Message Center" when their COLA notice is online, the agency said.
 In total, the Social Security Administration is sharing COLA notices with 76 million retirees, people with disabilities and survivors who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income (SSI).
 What is the COLA notice?
 Every year, the Social Security Administration contacts beneficiaries to share the cost-of-living adjustment and their benefit information for the following year.
 The COLA notice lists "exact dates and dollar amounts of an individual's new benefit amount and any deductions."
 These notices were once mailed to all beneficiaries' homes. Since 2018, most beneficiaries have used the online option, which is the fastest way to access the document.
 Some still receive letters in the mail: "Individuals who have not enrolled in paperless notices in my Social Security will receive their COLA notice by mail in December," the announcement said.
 The information in the notice primarily serves as confirmation of the adjustment, which was announced a month ago. Nothing in the notice should be a surprise.
 "It is possible that your friend or family member will receive their notice in the mail before you," an FAQ read . "Please wait until January before contacting SSA about your mailed notice."
 Most retirees will receive their first checks with the 2027 adjustment in January. The first SSI payments with the COLA are scheduled to go out on the last day of 2026 (Dec. 31), due to a calendar quirk around the holidays.
